questions.source_content:
OFFICE ORDER
Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Bharatpur
Date: 5 September 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/212)
Subject: Operational Review of ICT Computer Labs and Smart Classrooms in Government Schools (Phase-1)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Bharatpur division are hereby informed that under 'Operational Review of ICT Computer Labs and Smart Classrooms in Government Schools', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 10 September in the central friday wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #312) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Bharatpur, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and friday movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Bharatpur), 2. Budget Reconciliation #122, 3. Digital Indexing.
Joint Secretary to Government
Vikas Kumar Pareek
solution_steps: 1. Select the date line.
2. Click Center align, Italic, and Font 'Cambria'.
